{{Top|leg}}
The '''Core Worlds Travel Clearance''' was a document that was required of all [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] if a ship was to enter the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], which indicated their permission to conduct spacefaring business in the Core.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
